$comment: Hard marginal gzip KiB ceilings for splitting-aware production ESM. Each route adds one anchored component to the representative shell in $baseline. Initial bytes include only the entry and transitively static chunks; dynamic chunks remain covered by total-cost budgets. Preserve passing canaries, shell imports and optional-peer exclusions. Reviewed increases use exact measurements or the next 64-byte boundary, with at most 4% headroom. Shared modal ordering and reconnect handling measure 19,848 initial marginal gzip bytes for tour; only its exceeded ceiling advances to 19,904 bytes. The shared visually hidden form-control label option advances only the exceeded marginal ceilings to the next 64-byte boundary. Script-aware locale lookup and the 80-locale loader table measure 1,005 initial route gzip bytes for locale-loader, and 29,323 and 9,928 marginal bytes for model-select and mention-popover; only those exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. Named anchors for href menu items measure 18,204 initial marginal gzip bytes for menu; only its ceiling advances to 18,240 bytes. Build-time optional-peer import guards measure 1,083 initial route gzip bytes for locale-loader and 42,753 marginal bytes for date-input; only those exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. Upgrading scoped elements after adoption, for native scoped registries in iframe and detached documents, advances only the exceeded dist/utilities/scoped-registry-loader.js route ceiling to the next 64-byte boundary above its reviewed 11,470-byte measurement.
